shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find app lib -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls 01-app && echo "--- index ---" && head -60 index.md
cd /workspace && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat -n "$f"; done
ls -R __agent_eval__ | head -30
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rl "cacheComponents" . | head -30
ls 01-app/01-getting-started/ && echo "--- api ref ---" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/
cat 01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md
cat 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md
cat 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/io.md
sed -n '1,140p' 01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md
sed -n '140,300p' 01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md

cd /workspace && node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && echo "--- io export? ---" && grep -rn "\bio\b" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/cache.js node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

find .next -path '*product*' \( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.meta' \) 2>/dev/null | head && echo "=== shell HTML ===" && grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Loading inventory\|in stock' .next/server/app/product.html 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- prefetch (RSC) payload for /product ---"; curl -s -m 15 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/prefetch.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n'; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/prefetch.txt; echo "in-stock present? (want 0):"; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/prefetch.txt
curl -s -m 15 -D - -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /dev/null | head -20; echo "=== srv log ==="; tail -20 /tmp/srv.log

curl -s -L -m 15 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/prefetch.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n'; echo "title in prefetch (want >=1):"; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/prefetch.txt; echo "inventory in prefetch (want 0):"; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/prefetch.txt

echo "=== direct _rsc + RSC header ==="; curl -s -m 15 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=abc123' -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/p.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n'; head -8 /tmp/h.txt; echo "--- body markers ---"; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/p.txt; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/p.txt; wc -c /tmp/p.txt

curl -s -m 15 -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' -o /tmp/p.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n'; echo "bytes:"; wc -c < /tmp/p.txt; echo "title (want >=1):"; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/p.txt; echo "inventory (want 0):"; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/p.txt; echo "loading fallback:"; grep -c 'Loading inventory' /tmp/p.txt

ls -la .next/server/app/ | grep -i product; echo "=== prefetch.rsc contents ==="; for f in .next/server/app/product*.rsc; do echo "--- $f ---"; echo -n "title: "; grep -c 'Premium Widget' "$f"; echo -n "in stock: "; grep -c 'in stock' "$f"; echo -n "Loading: "; grep -c 'Loading inventory' "$f"; done

find .next/server/app/product .next/server/app/product.segments -type f | while read f; do echo "--- $f"; echo -n "  title:$(grep -c 'Premium Widget' "$f" 2>/dev/null) instock:$(grep -c 'in stock' "$f" 2>/dev/null) loading:$(grep -c 'Loading inventory' "$f" 2>/dev/null)"; echo; done

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git stash push app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts 2>&1 | tail -2 && echo "=== BEFORE-FIX BUILD ===" && npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E '^[┌├└│]|Static|Dynamic|Partial|Prerender' | head -20
git stash list; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== data.ts ==="; cat lib/data.ts

cp app/product/page.tsx /tmp/fixed-page.tsx && cp lib/data.ts /tmp/fixed-data.ts && git show HEAD:app/product/page.tsx > app/product/page.tsx && git show HEAD:lib/data.ts > lib/data.ts && echo "reverted to original:" && head -4 lib/data.ts

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "=== BEFORE-FIX prefetch artifacts ==="; find .next/server/app -path '*product*' \( -name '*.rsc' -o -name '*.html' \) -type f | while read f; do echo "  $f title:$(grep -c 'Premium Widget' "$f" 2>/dev/null)"; done
cp /tmp/fixed-page.tsx app/product/page.tsx && cp /tmp/fixed-data.ts lib/data.ts && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -9
git diff app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts; echo "=== side effects ==="; git diff --stat tsconfig.json; cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git checkout tsconfig.json && git status --short
